summary.headline: ICRA's Risk & Analytics mix reached 50% of group revenue in FY26, with Ratings growing 15.2% in H1 FY27 while non-Ratings run-rate stayed near INR 80 crore a quarter.
summary.overview: Management chose to focus on five strategic pillars rather than the quarter's numbers, which were covered in the investor presentation and press release. Ratings revenue reached INR 336 crore in FY26 (12.4% CAGR since FY21) with operating margin of 37.6%. Risk & Analytics (non-Ratings) revenue rose to INR 313 crore in FY26 from INR 114.9 crore five years earlier, but its quarterly run-rate has been flat at about INR 80 crore for the last few quarters, and margin is compressing as BankTech and CapTech gain mix. Management said D2K and Fintellix are still loss-making, that D2K became 100% owned only about 4-5 months ago, and that no profitability timeline will be guided.

segments.name: Ratings
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 336 crore in FY26 with 37.6% operating margin; H1 FY27 growth of 15.2%. Management attributed quarter-on-quarter noise to rating timing differences and did not give a market-share figure.

segments.name: Risk & Analytics: KnowTech
segments.commentary: About 60% of R&A revenue; described as showing muted growth. Anchor client (Moody's) share of KnowTech is about 49%, down from 80% five years ago. Anchor-client margins described as stable.

segments.name: Risk & Analytics: BankTech and CapTech
segments.commentary: About 40% of R&A revenue, with lower margins than KnowTech. BankTech sales moderated in H1; bulk of recurring renewals fall in Q1, so H2 is expected to be better.

segments.name: Group (R&A) structure
segments.commentary: Now run as three divisions across legal entities: KnowTech, BankTech and CapTech. D2K and Fintellix integration described as operationally complete at end-September 2026. Legal-entity simplification is still pending.

guidance_outlook: No numerical guidance given on segment growth, acquisition revenue or profitability; management said it does not provide guidance.
Management expects bank credit growth (21.4% in H1 FY27) to remain buoyant in H2 FY27, while bond issuance grew about 3.7%.
Margin compression in R&A as BankTech and CapTech mix rises is said to be in the budget.
Management expects D2K and Fintellix to become sustainably profitable and says there is a plan reviewed by the Board, but declined to give a year.
On the RBI risk-weight reset effective 1 April 2027, management views it as positive for ICRA but cannot quantify it; RBI clarification on reference period and method is still awaited.
No M&A amount earmarked; capital deployment and options such as buyback or special dividend are under review, with no decision disclosed.
capex_capacity: Technology and AI spend has been expanded significantly; management says ICRA is at a good place, with the platform roadmap now integrated across the three R&A divisions.
Plans for international expansion in Europe, the US and the Middle East, through organic and inorganic routes, with local presence to be built in targeted markets.
D2K reached 100% ownership about 4-5 months ago, which management says gives it latitude to make the investments it had deferred.
Single integrated product roadmap and unified customer service organisation created across R&A; legal-entity simplification to follow.
demand_pricing: Bank credit grew about 21.4% in H1 FY27; bond issuance grew about 3.7%. Management said Ratings revenue has been consistent over the last three to four years despite a bond-to-bank shift.
Ratings surveillance pricing: an enabling clause exists in agreements, and management is negotiating with some clients, with some traction. Analyst said a competitor had raised surveillance fees.
Moody's engagement is 80-90% recurring FTE revenue with about one year of budgeting visibility; projects are 10-20% of revenue.
Non-Moody's R&A engagements range from INR 10-20 lakh tickets to multi-crore deals; most customers take only one of ICRA's roughly five products.

More than half of R&A revenue is domestic; international work has been served largely through partners or remote engagement. Competitors include global information-service providers, systems integrators, regional players and the Big Four.

qa_highlights.question: Why has non-Ratings profit mix fallen while revenue share rose to 50%, and what does this mean for acquisition IRR, especially Fintellix?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said margin compression is expected as BankTech and CapTech (lower margin) grow, a conscious choice for a more balanced book, and is already in budget. It did not address IRR directly.

qa_highlights.question: Why has the non-Ratings quarterly run-rate stayed near INR 80 crore, and which parts are growing or declining?
qa_highlights.answer: KnowTech shows muted growth; BankTech sales moderated in H1 because renewals cluster in Q1 and H2 is usually better. Other verticals are growing reasonably well, with no guidance given.

qa_highlights.question: How much risk does a bond-yield spike pose to Ratings revenue, given ICRA's bond exposure?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said bank credit growth (21.4% H1) offsets weak bond issuance (3.7%), that bank credit is expected to stay buoyant in H2, and that ICRA's revenue has been consistent over the last 3-4 years.

qa_highlights.question: Is ICRA raising surveillance fees, as a competitor reportedly did?
qa_highlights.answer: Agreements have an enabling clause for surveillance pricing; management is renegotiating with clients and has seen some traction in certain cases.

qa_highlights.question: What is the outlook for Moody's relationship and headroom for growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said there is headroom and conversations are ongoing; the engagement is being reshaped with AI and automation, so higher engagement may not show directly in revenue.

qa_highlights.question: When will D2K and Fintellix become profitable and EPS-accretive, and what is the write-off or amortisation glide path?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it has a clear plan reviewed by the Board, but would not give a year. D2K was 60% owned until recently, which constrained investment; it became 100% owned about 4-5 months ago. R&A segment profit grew about 35% before D&A.

risks_watch: Non-Ratings revenue has been flat at about INR 80 crore a quarter; monitor whether H2 FY27 BankTech renewals and KnowTech growth lift the run-rate.
R&A margin compression as BankTech and CapTech mix rises, plus D&A from acquisition intangibles, weighs on segment profit; D2K and Fintellix remain loss-making with no guided breakeven.
Ratings exposure to bond issuance, which grew only about 3.7% in H1 FY27 against 21.4% bank credit growth; any shift could dilute revenue given higher bond fees.
Dependence on Moody's remains high (about 49% of KnowTech); the parent's engagement with its own Indian peer is growing faster, and ICRA gave no Moody's growth target.
Capital allocation (buyback or special dividend) is under review with no decision; RBI's Basel risk-weight reset (1 April 2027) is unquantified and awaits RBI clarification.
summary.management_tone: Confident on strategic direction and the five-pillar framework, but cautious and non-committal on numbers: it declined to give guidance on acquisition profitability, segment growth or Moody's headroom, and answered several questions with qualitative responses.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: No physical capacity figures disclosed; technology and AI spend has been expanded and D2K's 100% ownership (4-5 months ago) gives latitude for deferred investments, but no new capacity date was given.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Ratings revenue grew 15.2% in H1 FY27 and bank credit (21.4% H1 growth) is expected to stay buoyant in H2, while non-Ratings revenue has been flat at about INR 80 crore a quarter.

rows.label: New capex announcement

rows.label: Guidance upgrade

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: KnowTech growth is muted with Moody's share down to about 49% from 80%, BankTech sales moderated in H1, and D2K and Fintellix (about INR 25 crore combined FY26 loss) have no guided breakeven.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: A single integrated product roadmap across the three R&A divisions and AI-led platform work are in progress, but no specific product launch date was named.

rows.label: Ratings surveillance fee repricing
rows.why: Agreements carry an enabling clause and management is renegotiating with some clients with some traction, while a competitor reportedly raised surveillance fees; no quantum was given.

rows.label: D2K and Fintellix path to profitability
rows.why: Board-reviewed plan exists and integration is complete at end-September 2026, but management declined to give a year and the combined FY26 PAT loss is about INR 25 crore.

rows.label: Bank-driven Ratings demand in H2
rows.why: Bank credit grew 21.4% in H1 FY27 against bond issuance at 3.7%, and management expects bank credit to stay buoyant in H2 to support Ratings revenue.
